comparison.objective: Join two aluminium strips by setting one blind rivet and dispose of its snapped stem.
comparison.physical_skill: Load and insert a rivet, hold a hand riveter square and pressed down, repeatedly pump its handles, then empty the stem.
comparison.success_condition: Rivet set through both strips without a tilted or lifted pull, spent stem in tray, riveter returned and released.
comparison.reason: This is the closest fragment-disposal neighbor, but its central mechanism is tensile stem pulling and rivet deformation through cyclic handle pumping. The candidate instead requires bimanual impact through a separate coaxial mandrel to break four already-installed insert tangs without shifting the coils.

review_notes.purpose: Early concrete near-neighbor retrieval only. No requested verdict; independently read the complete original and compare objective, central physical ability and success conditions. Preserve overlap/uncertain if unresolved. Shared generic primitive alone is not sufficient, and industrial names/additional difficulty alone are not distinctness.
